It outlines bug fixes, priority enhancements (like improving graph loops, MCP connections, and AI model control), and new features (such as a UI designer tab, LLM routing, git integration, and browser functionality). The purpose is to organize and track development tasks systematically.

Key tasks include fixing image embedding issues, URL scraping, and server updates. Features planned: wiki link integration, smart chunking, inline AI edit, custom markdown editor, and an undo/redo system. Priority areas involve refining connections, security permissions, and improving AI-driven functionality.
